failure_summary.description: dispatch table is rule-based but no concrete examples showing how 2-3 representative user requests get resolved through clarification questions

edits.content:
## Worked dispatches (3 representative cases)

**Case 1**: User says "I have a breast H&E and want to know if there is a lot of TILs."
→ Single-slide morphology intent. Ask: organ confirmed (breast) ✓; HF gate ok? Run **pathology-lazyslide-he-analysis** with `feature_extraction(wsi, "uni2")` + zero-shot prompts `["TIL-rich", "TIL-poor"]`.

**Case 2**: User says "Compare TNBC vs luminal subtype on 200 H&E slides; AUROC > 0.8 acceptable."
→ Cohort + known labels + supervised intent. Ask: label column? GPU? Run **pathology-lazyslide-supervised-classification** with `feature_aggregation(encoder="mean")` + sklearn `LogisticRegression` + 5-fold CV.

**Case 3**: User says "Run cell segmentation on this slide and predict virtual CD8 staining at the cell level."
→ Composite intent crossing cell-segmentation + virtual-staining. Run **cell_segmentation** first (cell polygons), then **virtual_staining** with `model="gigatime"`, then aggregate per-cell CD8 means by intersecting `wsi.shapes["cells"]` with `wsi.images["gigatime_prediction"]`. Combine into ONE outputs/<run_id>/ directory.
